text: example, package can applied scRNA-seq dataset Wang et al. (2022), profiled human pluripotent stem cell-derived GnRH neuron differentiation cultures. count matrices available GEO accession GSE212901.
code: samples <- c("D22", "D24", "D26") dir.data <- "path/to/Wang_GSE212901_RAW"  seurat.list <- lapply(samples, function(x) {   counts <- Read10X(file.path(dir.data, x))   CreateSeuratObject(counts = counts, project = x) })  names(seurat.list) <- samples  obj <- merge(seurat.list[[1]], y = seurat.list[-1]) obj[["percent.mt"]] <- PercentageFeatureSet(obj, pattern = "^MT-")  obj <- subset(   obj,   subset = nFeature_RNA > 1000 &     nCount_RNA > 1500 &     percent.mt < 20 )  obj <- NormalizeData(obj) obj <- FindVariableFeatures(obj) obj <- ScaleData(obj) obj <- RunPCA(obj) obj <- RunUMAP(obj, dims = 1:30)

title: Classify GnRH marker candidates into developmental programs — gnrh_marker_programs
text: function designed used downstream marker discovery overlap analysis. reads marker tables generated multiple datasets, intersects dataset-specific unique markers GNRH1-coexpressed genes, assigns candidates curated GnRH developmental programs, reports confidence levels based co-expression, specificity, program membership. specificity score computed : $$ avg\_log2FC \times (pct.1 - pct.2) \times -log10(p\_val\_adj + \epsilon) $$ \(\epsilon = 1e-300\). Missing columns handled safely replaced conservative default values. Confidence levels assigned follows: high: unique, GNRH1-coexpressed, assigned developmental program, specificity score greater equal min_high_score, classified generic neuronal marker. medium: unique, GNRH1-coexpressed, specificity score greater equal min_medium_score, classified generic. low: remaining candidates. Biologically, candidate_table separates reference GnRH markers, generic neuronal markers, potentially novel GnRH-associated markers, context-specific candidates. Computationally, genes prioritized dataset specificity, GNRH1 co-expression, developmental program membership, marker specificity score.
